'''Matt Guinn''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Oxford tournament]] on 9 December 2000 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to Ivan Kanner's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1563">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-20-12-9-00-mara-jade-tourney-oxford-ncd1563/ 12-9-00-mara-jade-tourney-oxford-nc], DeckTech (Ivan "ZippyDaJedi" Kanner, 20 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-20-12-9-00-mara-jade-tourney-oxford-ncd1563/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
